cues: Sericulture is rearing silkworms for silk.
The mulberry silkworm, Bombyx mori, has been domesticated so long that the moth cannot fly and does not exist in the wild.
It is monophagous: it eats mulberry leaves and nothing else, so growing mulberry is half the job.
